aiSummary: In October 2026, Chrome for Android led browser versions (tablet) in Italy at 43.86% (market share of tracked page views / usage). Chrome iPad ranked second at 22.54%, followed by Safari iPad at 19.87%.

faqs.question: Which item leads browser versions (tablet) in Italy?
faqs.answer: Chrome for Android leads at 43.86% in October 2026 (market share of tracked page views / usage). Source: https://gs.statcounter.com/browser-version-market-share/tablet/italy.

faqs.question: What does the market share of tracked page views / usage metric mean?
faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for browser versions (tablet) in Italy?
faqs.answer: Chrome for Android (43.86%), Chrome iPad (22.54%), Safari iPad (19.87%) in October 2026.
